name: GATTO
label: GATTO / BLACK-CAT COMMUNITY
concept: A sculpted black-cat world with fine charcoal fur, expressive amber-gold eyes, tapered cheeks, detailed pointed ears and slender gold orbital rings.
description: GATTO is a Solana community coin built by Cabilval / Yaga, with a black Italian cat at its heart.

building.name: Trattoria Gatto
building.description: A gathering place in Parallax’s imagined Italian city, inspired by the trattoria in GATTO’s official artwork.

buildDescription: The project describes a public community experiment, with development shaped by participation and progress.
funFact: Gatto means “cat” in Italian. A whole crew of cats? Gatti.
joke: Nine lives. Nine espressos. Still asleep on your keyboard.
